findings.text: the interface account says the pin table "retires three public constants and their re-export, and adds the one table PINNED_DESCRIPTIONS", but the node it describes (jtmm-machine-keyed-selection, commit 16a7fa4f) also added three public names to artifact_resolution.__all__ — PinRow, pinned_row and pinned_rows — so the account is not the complete inventory it is presented as, and a reader migrating to the table would not learn the row type or the accessors exist
